feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: The Supreme Court rejects Trump's mail voting restrictions for this year's midterms
entry.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected the Trump administration's request to allow mail-in voting restrictions under a U.S. Postal Service plan for the midterm general election.

entry.title: Trump's EPA repeals pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
entry.summary: The Trump administration is eliminating limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Environmental groups say this will impact the climate and public health.

entry.title: What's next for Senator John Fetterman?
entry.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks with Adam Jentleson, former chief of staff for Pennsylvania Democratic Senator John Fetterman, about recent revelations about Sen. Fetterman's work performance.

entry.title: A roundtable on the rapid acceleration of AI
entry.summary: AI companies this weekend pushed out a new message: They want to slow down. This comes after several companies disclosed AI-related security incidents and raised concerns about the technology's future risks.

entry.title: Step, stand, stairs
entry.summary: When it comes to longevity, lots of research has shown how much you move matters. But a new study finds your pace may also be key -- even if you fall far short of daily step goals.

entry.title: Kennedy Center says it's close to bankruptcy and will not be able to pay staff "within weeks"
entry.summary: In two board resolutions made public Monday, the arts institution says it is in a dire financial and physical state —– and that only President Trump can "rescue" it.

entry.title: Psychedelics get a hearing at FDA
entry.summary: The Trump administration has signaled it's behind the psychedelic renaissance, but there are still big questions about how these drugs will be administered once they are approved by the FDA.

entry.title: What's the latest with the Trump admin's promise on lower drug prices in Medicaid?
entry.summary: The Trump admin's drug price deals came with a promise to offer lower prices in Medicaid. But the goalposts keep moving. Instead of all drugs, it's just one or two. And the deadlines for states to voluntarily sign on has been pushed back twice. So what's the status?

entry.title: Israel is 'dismantling Palestinian life' says Israeli human rights group
entry.summary: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used to "ethnically cleanse" the West Bank of Palestinians.

entry.title: Inside the unprecedented threats election officials are facing ahead of mid-terms
entry.summary: Hundreds of election officials from around the country are meeting to discuss how to defend the integrity of the mid-term elections, including against federal government interference.
